'''Jim Colson''' was one of Decipher's first [[Squadron Members]], listed as Gold 5 FL in the Dagobah region from Huntsville, Alabama.<ref name="decsq-dagobah" /><ref name="decsq-prof" /> The fan site's Squadron Members table marks him Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

[[File:Jim Colson DecipherCon 2000.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Colson at DecipherCon 2000 (still from Brandon Baity's video)]]

He answered Decipher's call for Squadron Members in 1996. For almost a year he was the only tournament director in a three-state area of Dagobah and Yavin 4, running monthly events in Huntsville, Birmingham and Nashville. He was also a Star Trek CCG Ambassador.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).

== 2022 interview ==
In a 2022 interview Colson said he came to SWCCG from the ''Star Trek'' CCG and pre-ordered six cases of [[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]. His first tournament, in Huntsville, drew two players who drove up from Tuscaloosa. His monthly circuit in Huntsville, Nashville and Birmingham included the first tournament [[Steven Lewis]] played. [[Kyle Heuer]] told him he had run more tournaments than any other Decipher volunteer.<ref name="colson">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=307s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], BoardMatt, YouTube (uploaded 24 April 2022), at 05:07. Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG Insider Stories with Jim Colson (transcript)]].</ref><ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=383s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], BoardMatt, YouTube (uploaded 24 April 2022), at 06:23. Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG Insider Stories with Jim Colson (transcript)]].</ref> He also ran events at Gen Con, DecipherCon and regional conventions, and he later became card games director at Dragon Con.<ref name="colson-0740">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=460s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], BoardMatt, YouTube (uploaded 24 April 2022), at 07:40. Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG Insider Stories with Jim Colson (transcript)]].</ref> At the end of the license period he visited Decipher's Norfolk offices as a [[Players Committee]] representative and took some boxes of material for the PC.<ref name="colson-2356">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=1436s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], BoardMatt, YouTube (uploaded 24 April 2022), at 23:56. Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG Insider Stories with Jim Colson (transcript)]].</ref>

Colson explained "Premiere Blue" cards as Premiere cards printed without the yellow ink. He said Cartamundi's Belgian plant was at capacity in the mid-1990s. The ''Star Trek'' CCG's first expansion, ''Alternate Universe'', spent most of a near year-long delay in customs. Moving some printing to PBM Graphics in the United States gave Decipher closer quality control.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=1652s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], BoardMatt, YouTube (uploaded 24 April 2022), at 27:32. Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG Insider Stories with Jim Colson (transcript)]].</ref><ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=1734s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], BoardMatt, YouTube (uploaded 24 April 2022), at 28:54. Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG Insider Stories with Jim Colson (transcript)]].</ref><ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=1848s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], BoardMatt, YouTube (uploaded 24 April 2022), at 30:48. Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG Insider Stories with Jim Colson (transcript)]].</ref> He said Premiere, A New Hope and Hoth were developed at the same time, and that volunteers playtested Endor about six months before its release.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=1995s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], BoardMatt, YouTube (uploaded 24 April 2022), at 33:15. Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG Insider Stories with Jim Colson (transcript)]].</ref> Before the license ended, Decipher consulted him about relic cards containing cut film cells, and it had discussed selling factory-graded cards.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=2367s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], BoardMatt, YouTube (uploaded 24 April 2022), at 39:27. Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG Insider Stories with Jim Colson (transcript)]].</ref><ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=2694s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], BoardMatt, YouTube (uploaded 24 April 2022), at 44:54. Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG Insider Stories with Jim Colson (transcript)]].</ref> He said the DecipherCon Corellian Corvette and Imperial-class Star Destroyer tournament foils were given one per attendee, and that leftover copies went into the next year's regional tournament kits. Reflections Gold was playtested only inside Decipher.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=3606s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], BoardMatt, YouTube (uploaded 24 April 2022), at 1:00:06. Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG Insider Stories with Jim Colson (transcript)]].</ref><ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=3849s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], BoardMatt, YouTube (uploaded 24 April 2022), at 1:04:09. Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG Insider Stories with Jim Colson (transcript)]].</ref>

== Collecting ==
Colson wore a Gold 5 Squadron Member polo embroidered GOLD 5, with a Rebel Alliance roundel and STAR WARS CCG GOLD SQUAD, in a 2022 interview.<ref name="colson-gold5">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=154s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], [[BoardMatt]], YouTube (24 April 2022), at 2:34. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015174310/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o Internet Archive]; [https://archive.org/details/youtube-PRRkRBHlo-o Internet Archive item].</ref> He also kept vinyl velcro convention-booth cards, including a Death Star and Chewbacca.<ref name="colson-velcro">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=1182s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], [[BoardMatt]], YouTube (24 April 2022), at 19:42. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015174310/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o Internet Archive]</ref> He kept a Special Edition vinyl booth card of a Dark Side capital starship.<ref name="colson-se-vinyl">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qOOinRpisyg&t=2372s Star Trek CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], [[BoardMatt]], YouTube (9 April 2023), at 39:32. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016115248/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qOOinRpisyg Internet Archive]</ref> He showed a delaminated card whose metal layer had separated from the stock.<ref name="colson-delam">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=1373s Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], [[BoardMatt]], YouTube (24 April 2022), at 22:53. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015174310/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o Internet Archive]</ref> An oversized [[Chewbacca]] convention-booth card in [[Andy Talaga]]'s collection came from Colson.<ref name="talaga-weird">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4dR5MIPH4h4 Star Wars CCG - Most Interesting and Strangest Things in Our Collections with Special Guest Andy], [[BoardMatt]] with [[Andy Talaga]] (29 May 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20220529152129/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4dR5MIPH4h4 Internet Archive]; [https://archive.org/details/youtube-4dR5MIPH4h4 Internet Archive item].</ref>
